records.subject: Energy and Utilities
records.title: Electricity Tariff, Monthly
records.footnote: Electricity Tariff is the price at which consumers buy electricity from SP Group.  Data exclude Goods and Services Tax.

row.footnote: Refers to electricity prices for domestic consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 400V/230V.
Refers to electricity prices for commercial and industrial consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 400V/230V.

row.rowText: High Tension Small Supplies - Contracted Capacity Charge
row.footnote: Refers to the monthly charges for the grid capacity requested by the consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity of less than 1,700kW.

row.rowText: High Tension Small Supplies - Uncontracted Capacity Charge
row.uoM: Dollar Per Chargeable Kilowatt Per Month
row.footnote: Refers to the monthly charges for consumers with maximum electricity demand exceeding the contracted capacity and taking supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity of less than 1,700kW.

row.rowText: High Tension Small Supplies - Peak Period (7.00 AM To 11.00 PM)
row.footnote: Refers to the electricity prices for consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity of less than 1,700kW during the peak period of 7.00 am to 11.00 pm.

row.rowText: High Tension Small Supplies - Off-Peak Period (11.00 PM To 7.00 AM)
row.footnote: Refers to the electricity prices for consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity of less than 1,700kW during the off-peak period of 11.00 pm to 7.00 am.

row.rowText: High Tension Small Supplies - Reactive Power Charge
row.uoM: Cent Per Chargeable Kilovolt Ampere Reactive Hour
row.footnote: Refers to the reactive power charges for the reactive power consumption in excess of 62% of the electricity consumption in the month.

row.rowText: High Tension Large Supplies - Contracted Capacity Charge
row.footnote: Refers to the monthly charges for the grid capacity requested by the consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity between 1,700kW and 12,750kW for 1 or 2 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85) or between 12,751kW and 25,500kW for 3 or 4 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85).

row.rowText: High Tension Large Supplies - Uncontracted Capacity Charge
row.uoM: Dollar Per Chargeable Kilowatt Per Month
row.footnote: Refers to the monthly charges for consumers with maximum electricity demand exceeding the contracted capacity and taking supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity between 1,700kW and 12,750kW for 1 or 2 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85) or between 12,751kW and 25,500kW for 3 or 4 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85).

row.rowText: High Tension Large Supplies - Peak Period (7.00 AM To 11.00 PM)
row.footnote: Refers to the electricity prices for consumer who are taking electricity supplies at 22kV or 6.6kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity between 1,700kW and 12,750kW for 1 or 2 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85) or between 12,751kW and 25,500kW for 3 or 4 HT 22kV services (based on power factor of 0.85) during the peak period of 7.00 am to 11.00 pm.

row.rowText: Extra High Tension Supplies - Contracted Capacity Charge
row.footnote: Refers to the monthly charges for the grid capacity requested by the consumers who are taking electricity supplies at 66kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity between 25,501kW and 84,999kW for service connection from the nearest feasible 66kV substation (based on power factor of 0.85) or between 85,000kW and 170,000kW for connection from the nearest feasible 66kV source station (based on power factor of 0.85).

row.rowText: Extra High Tension Supplies - Peak Period (7.00 AM To 11.00 PM)
row.footnote: Refers to the electricity prices for consumers who are taking supplies at 66kV, 50Hz, 3-phase, 3-wire for connection with Contracted Capacity between 25,501kW and 84,999kW for service connection from the nearest feasible 66kV substation (based on power factor of 0.85) or between 85,000kW and 170,000kW for connection from the nearest feasible 66kV source station (based on power factor of 0.85) during the peak period of 7.00 am to 11.00 pm.
